item.title: Ringier Sports Media Group to Discontinue sportal.hu
item.description: Ringier Sports Media Group (RSMG) will discontinue operations of its Hungarian online sports platform sportal.hu. The decision follows a strategic portfolio review and reflects a careful assessment of market and economic conditions.

item.title: Ringier Advertising Exclusively Commercialises yallo TV: A New Premium Environment for Video Advertising
item.description: Starting January 1, 2026, Ringier Advertising will take over the exclusive commercialisation of yallo TV, a leading provider of digital TV streaming in Switzerland. This partnership offers advertisers access to a premium TV environment with the widest reach and innovative advertising opportunities in the rapidly growing streaming market.

item.title: Ticketcorner: Evi Lehmann-Prieler becomes new CFO
item.description: Evi Lehmann-Prieler will join Ticketcorner's management team as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) from February 2026. With her appointment, the ticketing company gains a proven financial specialist with many years of experience and a clear understanding of digital business models.

item.title: New attendance record for women's ice hockey in Zurich – EqualVoice, Blick and ZSC Lions send a strong signal for visibility
item.description: Zurich's women's ice hockey scene set a historic milestone on Saturday, January 24: The championship game between the ZSC Lions Frauen and EV Zug was watched by 4,997 spectators in the arena. This set a new league record in the PostFinance Women's League and marked a significant achievement for women's ice hockey in Switzerland, particularly in Zurich.

item.title: EqualVoice United Continues to Grow: University Hospital Zurich, Zurich Opera House and Finance App Yuh Join
item.description: Starting today, the University Hospital Zurich (USZ), one of the largest and leading medical centers in Switzerland, will become a member of EqualVoice United. Also new to the initiative is Yuh, a fully digital Swiss finance app. The start-up was founded in 2021 and has been wholly owned by Swissquote since July 2025. The Zurich Opera House, one of Switzerland's most renowned cultural centers, has also become a member of EqualVoice United.

item.title: “The Celebrity Scammers”: New izzy Film Exposes the Billion-Dollar Business of Fake Celebrities
item.description: Cedric Schild and the izzy team make scammers sing. This time, literally. Available now for all subscribers on Blick+.

item.title: EqualVoice welcomes Nobel Peace Prize laureate Tawakkol Karman and AWS top manager Chris Keller to its Advisory Board – EqualVoice-Factor shows further progress in Switzerland & internationally
item.description: The EqualVoice initiative by Ringier is gaining prominent international members: Tawakkol Karman, Nobel Peace Prize laureate, journalist, and human rights activist from Yemen, and Chris Keller, General Manager Europe Central at Amazon Web Services (AWS), are two outstanding personalities joining the international and national EqualVoice Advisory Boards.

item.title: Ringier Media Switzerland acquires AdUnit: Strategic expansion of regional and digital advertising commercialisation at Ringier Advertising
item.description: Ringier Media Switzerland (RMS) is acquiring AdUnit, previously a subsidiary of the Goldbach Group, which belongs to the TX Group, effective March 1, 2026. The AdUnit software solution for agencies, publishers, sales networks, and SMEs is an ideal addition for Ringier Advertising: It facilitates access to high-quality Swiss advertising environments and will make booking even simpler and more intuitive in the future, especially for SMEs.

item.title: Predrag Mihailović appointed Editor-in-Chief of Blic; Marko Stjepanović assumes new role within Ringier’s Global Media Unit
item.description: Belgrade, 13 March 2026 – Predrag Mihailović has been appointed Editor-in-Chief of Blic and will assume this role alongside his position as General Manager of Sportal Serbia, effective 16 March 2026. Marko Stjepanović, the current Editor-in-Chief of Blic and Editorial Director of its digital editions, will continue his career within Ringier Media as Head of Editorial Product & Audience Strategy, Global Media Unit.

item.title: «Digital Shapers 2026»: Switzerland celebrates its digital visionaries
item.description: For the eighth time, BILANZ, Handelszeitung, PME, and digitalswitzerland are honoring one hundred individuals who are significantly shaping digital Switzerland. Tonight, for the first time, they will be celebrated as the “Digital Shapers 2026” at a major gala event.
